text.description_html:
Schlage Wakefield Handleset with Andover Knob

The Wakefield has a classic oval design with elegant, curved lines; it features two small oval faces and a graceful sweeping handle. The two-piece design offers flexibility for doors with nonstandard hole locations while providing a subtle classic appearance for smaller entranceways. This Schlage Wakefield Handleset is paired with the with Andover Knob.

Single Cylinder Handleset: Key operated from the outside and thumb turn operated from the inside.

Features and Specifications of the Wakefield Handleset with Andover Knob:

  • Finish: polished brass exterior with oil rubbed bronze interior.
  • Precision engineered.
  • 100% solid forged brass.
  • ANSI A156.5 Grade 1 Certification.
  • Solid one-pice deadbolt design that resists sawing and protects against hammer and crowbar attacks.
  • Concealed mounting screws for a sleeker design.
  • Door frame reinforcer with 3"screws.
  • Universal latch and bolt fits either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets
  • Door Thickness Range: 1-5/8" to 1-3/4"

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
